Interactive Chinese Video Learning Platform

MandarinFlow

A YouTube-based Chinese learning app that brings subtitles, pinyin, translation, vocabulary, and stroke order into one experience.

Why I built it

"When I started learning Mandarin I noticed that learners tend to forget the complex structure of Mandarin words, and it is boring to learn through books, dictionaries. Furthermore, switching from Youtube to dictionary tabs consumes my attention span and learning time. From the above concerns, I conduct a websites that's help Mandarin users to learn while watching videos. By interact with the vocabulary below the video, they will know it's meaning in different context, how it is written and save words for later revision"

Features

01

Watch YouTube videos with subtitles and pinyin, following the words as you listen.

subtitle will be syncronize with the youtube's timeline

02

Interact with the vocabulary below the video to explore Vietnamese meanings and understand how words are used in different contexts.

03

See how Chinese characters are written with stroke-order animations alongside the vocabulary you are learning.

04

Save vocabulary to your word list and return to it for later revision.
